Questions on commercial real estate lending. Over the second quarter, a significant net share 
of banks reported having tightened standards for all CRE loan categories. Meanwhile, moderate 
net shares of banks reported weaker demand for construction and land development loans and for 
nonfarm nonresidential loans, and a modest net share of banks reported stronger demand for loans 
secured by multifamily properties. Furthermore, a significant net share of foreign banks reported 
tighter standards for CRE loans, on net, while a modest net share of foreign banks reported weaker 
demand for such loans.
